code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, microcytosis, increased red cell distribution width, and mild lymphopenia. There are also mild monocytosis and basophilia, and elevated chloride. These findings may suggest a possible underlying respiratory disorder, bone marrow suppression or infection, and possible early anemia. Correlation with clinical findings and further investigation are recommended.
